title: Construct a uniform FPTAS conditional on an explicitly specified logarithmic-seed circuit PRG
statement: Assume specified uniform G_W with seed<=ceil(c log2 W), time<=C_G W^d and additive1/8 fooling of every Boolean circuit of <=W gates. Fix credited bounded-time rational-bit permanent FPRAS with q_run(K) bound and success>=3/4 at eta=epsilon/4. Let W=C0(q_run(K)+K)^3; enumerate all seeds, run estimator tapes, take exact rational median z and return [z/(1+eta),z/(1-eta)]. A proof-only success-test circuit can hardwire polynomial-height exact P,D; universal fooling gives >=5/8 good outputs, so median is correct.
